buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) 1) The CPU, Monitor, Keyboard and Mouse must be supplied by the same OEM as the desktop computer. O EM logo/trademark must be permanently embossed on the devices. Sticker-based branding shall not be ac cepted. 2) The OEM must provide a built-in pre-boot system hardware diagnostics utility. 3) The OEM must provide an online system hardware diagnostics facility through its official website. 4) The OEM must provide facility on its official website for downloading updates of pre-installed software, d evice drivers and firmware. 5) The OEM must support recovery media creation through its official website to reinstall the operating sys tem to its original factory condition as configured by the OEM. 6) The date of manufacture of the supplied desktop computers must not be more than six (6) months prior to the date of delivery. 7) The offered desktop computers must comply with applicable certifications including MS Windows, Energ

y Star, EPEAT, EPR, RoHS, TCO 8.0 or higher, BIS, and any other relevant Indian statutory certifications. 8) The OEM must be MII compliant for the offered product. 9) Desktop computer datasheets along with valid and relevant certifications for all hardware components must be submitted. 10) A bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) must be submitted by the bidder and duly confir med by the OEM for the desktop computers and total antivirus protection. General or non-specific authoriz ation letters shall not be accepted. 11) Windows 11 Professional must be factory pre-loaded by the OEM. The bidder must submit: a) An OEM undertaking letter at the time of bidding; and b) A declaration letter from the OEM confirming installation of the factory pre-loaded genuine operating sys tem. 12) Documentary proof from the OEM for certification of Windows, Ubuntu, and Linux OS support must be s ubmitted. The quoted desktop computer model shall not be accepted if Linux OS support is not available o n the OEM’s official website. 13) Specifications and warranty details of the offered desktop computers must be verifiable through serial number-based search/tracking on the OEM’s official website. Documentary proof from the OEM must be su bmitted. 14) The OEM must provide a Non-Malicious Code Undertaking confirming that all proposed desktop compu ters, keyboards, mice, Windows OS, total antivirus protection, and office applications do not contain any e mbedded malicious code. 15) The desktop computers must be seamlessly integrated on a single platform. Desktop computer, keybo ard, and mouse must be from the same OEM for smooth operation and unified support. 16) The bidder must submit documentary proof from the OEM, on OEM letterhead, declaring the percentag e of local content for each equipment. 17) All documents issued by the OEM and submitted by the bidder must be ink-signed and stamped. 18) The contract shall be awarded to the Lowest Evaluated Bidder (L1). 19) The OEM must have a minimum experience of ten (10) years in manufacturing and supplying high-end desktop computers. Proof to be provided to show past 10 years OEM manufactured & supplied desktop/wo rkstation performance, C-DAC reserves the right to evaluate the product offered by the OEM. 20) Comprehensive onsite warranty of three (3) years is mandatory and must be visible in the OEM’s publi c domain. 21) A unique device serial number must be provided at the time of supply. The buyer/consignee must be a ble to verify complete product details, including configuration, warranty through the OEM’s official website . 22) The seller must not change or alter the configuration of the factory pre-loaded machine. The buyer ma y verify the same through the OEM. Mandatory Documents to be Uploaded on GeM A) Signed Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF), strictly bid-specific. General authorization letters shall not be accepted. B) Datasheet of the offered product, duly signed and stamped, along with product compliance sheet on O EM letterhead. C) Bidder self-declaration confirming that the bidder has never been blacklisted by any Government entity . D) Letter of acceptance of all terms and conditions on bidder’s letterhead, duly signed and stamped. E) Malicious Code Certificate duly signed by the OEM. F) Land Border Certificate as per Annexure-A regarding restriction on procurement from bidders of countri es sharing a land border with India must be submitted on OEM letterhead, duly signed and stamped. G) Genuine Operating System Certificate from the OEM, duly signed and stamped. Microsoft OS may be s ourced from authorized Microsoft distributors such as Redington, Ingram, or their authorized resellers. Sup porting documents must be uploaded by the bidder. 23. EMD can be submitted in the form of a Demand Draft drawn in favour of C-DAC payable at Pune or thr oug h on-line mode / BG. Bank Details for submitting EMD. Name of Bank: IDBI Bank, Gokhale Road, Pune – 411016, Account No: 60010010004258 IFSC / NEFT Code: IBKL0000600 24. Bidders can share the queries (if any) by email to: mmg@cdac.in well in advance before the bid end da te.
